social.copy:
What is Se’kret Bip designed to do?

Se’kret Bip is a privacy-first creative and emotional-growth product for teens and their families, with journaling, comfort, and permission-aware family experience concepts.

Not a therapy or emergency service. Features in source do not prove all member journeys are production ready.

Project evidence: https://github.com/jussray/Sekret-Bip

#SekretBip #FamilyTechnology #TeenWellbeingDesign #PrivacyFirst #AppDevelopment
social.mediaAltText: Illustrative purple scrapbook bedroom scene, journal and phone interface with the Se’kret Bip logo; no real teen users or companion portraits.
